title: Human-in-the-Loop for Data Collection: a Multi-Target Counter Narrative Dataset to Fight Online Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on developing a methodology and dataset to generate counter-narratives against online hate speech, which is an inherently ethical objective. The work directly involves evaluating and countering hate speech targeted at religious groups, specifically mentioning 'JEWS' and 'MUSLIM' as hate targets. This places the evaluation of language and argumentation within a distinct moral framework that includes religious dimensions.
